elements.name: Alert
elements.desc: +5 bonus to initiative, can't be surprised while conscious, and hidden creatures don't gain advantage against you.

elements.name: Athlete
elements.desc: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1. Stand up from prone using 5 feet of movement, climb without extra cost, and make running jumps after moving only 5 feet.

elements.name: Actor
elements.desc: Increase your Charisma by 1. You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks when trying to pass as a different person, and can mimic speech and sounds.

elements.name: Charger
elements.desc: When you Dash, you can use a bonus action to make a melee weapon attack or shove a creature.

elements.name: Crossbow Expert
elements.desc: Ignore loading property of crossbows, no disadvantage when within 5 feet of a hostile creature, and can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow.

elements.name: Defensive Duelist
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Dexterity 13+. Use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against one melee attack while wielding a finesse weapon.

elements.name: Dual Wielder
elements.desc: +1 bonus to AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. Can use two-weapon fighting even if the weapons aren't light. Draw or stow two weapons when you normally could only draw one.

elements.name: Dungeon Delver
elements.desc: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to find secret doors, advantage on saves against traps, and resistance to trap damage. Search for traps at a normal pace.

elements.name: Durable
elements.desc: Increase your Constitution by 1. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number you regain equals twice your Constitution modifier.

elements.name: Elemental Adept
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Choose a damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder). Spells ignore resistance to that type, and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

elements.name: Grappler
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Strength 13+. Advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling, and can use an action to try to pin it.

elements.name: Great Weapon Master
elements.desc: On a critical hit or a kill, make a melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Can take a -5 penalty to hit with a heavy weapon to deal +10 damage.

elements.name: Healer
elements.desc: Use a healer's kit to stabilize a creature and restore 1d6+4+target's max Hit Dice in HP. Does not work on undead or constructs.

elements.name: Heavily Armored
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Proficiency with medium armor. Increase Strength by 1 and gain proficiency with heavy armor.

elements.name: Heavy Armor Master
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Proficiency with heavy armor. Increase Strength by 1. While wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons is reduced by 3.

elements.name: Inspiring Leader
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Charisma 13+. Spend 10 minutes inspiring companions to grant up to 6 creatures temporary HP equal to your level + Charisma modifier.

elements.name: Keen Mind
elements.desc: Increase your Intelligence by 1. Always know which way is north, the hours until sunrise/sunset, and can accurately recall anything seen or heard in the past month.

elements.name: Lightly Armored
elements.desc: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, and gain proficiency with light armor.

elements.name: Linguist
elements.desc: Increase your Intelligence by 1. Learn three languages. Can create written ciphers.

elements.name: Lucky
elements.desc: You have 3 luck points. Spend one to roll an additional d20 on an attack, ability check, or saving throw, or when an attack is made against you.

elements.name: Mage Slayer
elements.desc: React to attack a spellcaster within 5 feet. Advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet. Spells cast by creatures you damage have disadvantage on concentration saves.

elements.name: Magic Initiate
elements.desc: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from a chosen class's spell list. You can cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest.

elements.name: Martial Adept
elements.desc: Learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master archetype and gain one superiority die (d6).

elements.name: Medium Armor Master
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Proficiency with medium armor. No disadvantage on Stealth checks from medium armor, and can add 3 (instead of 2) to AC from Dexterity.

elements.name: Mobile
elements.desc: Speed increases by 10 feet. Difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement when you Dash. Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

elements.name: Moderately Armored
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Proficiency with light armor. Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

elements.name: Mounted Combatant
elements.desc: Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. Can force an attack targeting your mount to target you instead. Mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save.

elements.name: Observant
elements.desc: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1. Can lip-read. Gain +5 bonus to passive Perception and passive Investigation.

elements.name: Polearm Master
elements.desc: Attack with the opposite end of a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear as a bonus action (1d4 bludgeoning). Opportunity attacks when creatures enter your reach.

elements.name: Resilient
elements.desc: Choose one ability score. Increase it by 1 and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

elements.name: Ritual Caster
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom 13+. Acquire a ritual book and learn two 1st-level ritual spells. Can cast them as rituals.

elements.name: Savage Attacker
elements.desc: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

elements.name: Sentinel
elements.desc: Opportunity attacks stop creature movement. Disengage doesn't protect against your opportunity attacks. Reaction to attack a creature that attacks an ally within 5 feet.

elements.name: Sharpshooter
elements.desc: No disadvantage on ranged attacks at long range. Ignore half and three-quarters cover. Can take -5 penalty to hit to deal +10 damage.

elements.name: Shield Master
elements.desc: Bonus action to shove with shield. Add shield AC to Dexterity saves against effects targeting only you. Take no damage on a successful Dex save against an area effect.

elements.name: Skilled
elements.desc: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

elements.name: Skulker
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Dexterity 13+. Can hide when lightly obscured. Missing with a ranged attack doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on Perception checks.

elements.name: Spell Sniper
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Spellcasting. Double the range of your spells. Ignore half and three-quarters cover. Learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll.

elements.name: Tavern Brawler
elements.desc: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1. Proficient with improvised weapons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 damage. Bonus action to grapple after hitting with unarmed strike or improvised weapon.

elements.name: Tough
elements.desc: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat, and by +2 every level thereafter.

elements.name: War Caster
elements.desc: Prerequisite: Spellcasting. Advantage on Constitution saves for concentration. Can perform somatic components with weapons/shield in hand. Can cast a spell instead of an opportunity attack.

elements.name: Weapon Master
elements.desc: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
